主要内容: Nordic American Tankers Limited filed an amendment to Form 6-K on January 18, 2012, which modifies three previous Form 6-K filings made on May 12, 2011, August 9, 2011, and November 7, 2011. The amendment clarifies that these reports should not be incorporated by reference into the Company’s registration statement on Form F-3 ASR (File No. 333-162171), which was filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and became effective on September 28, 2009. The amendment was submitted to the SEC as part of the Company’s regulatory obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing was signed by Herbjørn Hansson, the Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, and President of Nordic American Tankers Limited.
